_comment: Edits written as prose: the sentence to change, the sentence to put in its
place, which tell it retires and why. `voice_rewrite.py --curate` resolves each
one against the chapter file and appends the exact-HTML entry to
data/voice_rewrites.json, refusing anything that is not one place in the file and
anything whose replacement would touch text inside a tag. `new` may be empty,
which deletes the sentence (and the whitespace after it). A refusal says so and
leaves the catalogue alone, so this file is always safe to re-run.
